scope: All13 tracked text blobs and4trees: all Python algorithms/abstracthash/main/benchmark, both shell/container launchers, Dockerfile,README,license,ignorefiles andtwoempty placeholders. No tracked media or README media references; external Docker website excluded.

findings.finding: Sequencehash identical under temporal reorder and repetition, so cannot certify video identity.
Scene segmentation drops entire no-cut sequence and trailing scene after last cut.
Longest common prefix abc/ab returns abc.
Zero sliding step repeats forever; control consumes only three yields. Short Bollinger input yields lag false values then IndexError.
Empty mseq/merge/compress crash; resolution parser valid8x8 raises TypeError, though CLI currently uses str rather than this parser.
All65536bytepair Hamming oracles and bounded positive interval/search/hash controls pass.
Main retains all frames before segmentation and allocates square scene distance matrix; no streaming/RSS/scale measurement.
Cache ID uses filename+resolution+FPS without source bytes/mtime/freshness/backend recipe; shell accepts any existing output without completed atomic publication.
CLI embeds unvalidated resolution inside shell command; no injection or Docker/shell side effects executed. Launcher ignores system command exit status.

Main uses eval on metadata timebase, assumes nb_frames, nonempty generics, mutates tuple scenes on adjacent merge, and uses sampled frame indexes in VLC time output without explicit FPS conversion. No original pipeline execution.
Hash is mean-threshold average hash, not DCTpHash; constant frames collapse. Flat dynamic normalization divides by zero. Pixel/color/alpha/frame/backend policy unqualified.
Benchmark random generator unseeded; CSV reports sequence length for insertion/std columns; cannot be performance/quality evidence.
mseq uses consumed filter iterators across DFS roots and potentially expensive path exploration; suffix storage/quadratic histogram/front-pop algorithms have scaling risks, not measured speed claims.

limits: No upstream automated suite declared; benchmark is random exploratory script, not executed.

AST-selected unchanged bodies with real NumPy2.3.5/Python3.12, not upstreamPython3.5/fullmodule imports. No skimage/skvideo/sklearn/FFmpeg/Docker/video corpus/original CLI runtime or quality/performance/platform proof.
No foreign production code adopted. Findings supply counterexamples and resource/cache requirements; no library speedup claimed.
